audit_items.proof_trace: `forceToggleAttendance` calls `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (service_role key, RLS fully bypassed) and performs no caller authorization — no `auth.getUser()` call, no `is_admin` check. The admin layout's `is_admin` gate (`src/app/admin/layout.tsx:L17-21`) only runs at page-render time (GET) and does not protect Server Action invocations (POST), unlike peer functions such as `getTeamWithMembersStatus` which explicitly verify `is_admin` before acting.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated non-admin member extracts the Next.js Server Action ID from the compiled client bundle, then sends a direct POST request with an arbitrary victim `userId` to force-insert fake attendance records for any member, completely bypassing RLS and admin-only access controls.
